title: BUILDING the ALL NEW WINSPACE T1600 AERO MACHINE!!!

takeaways.text: In October 2025 the shop-owner presenter quoted US$2,400 for the frameset with matching one-piece cockpit (he offers a 10% code) and US$2,800 for the SLC5.
Inside the frame he saw an even Kevlar-carbon weave; the fork's hollow brake-hose path let the hose drop straight out of its exit, which he rated better than his Tarmac SL8.
Di2 battery sits in a strap holder reachable without removing the bottom bracket; routing both hoses through the integrated bar took some fishing.

Without a model-specific front caliper adapter the caliper sat high on the 160 mm position, so he switched to 140 mm and found hose clearance tight; the stock 90 mm bar and 20 mm-setback post put him further over the front than his usual 120 mm stem.

disclosure: The description links the frame with the creator's discount code and discounted bearing products used in the build.
summary: Full home build of a T1600 frameset: cutting the steerer, routing through the integrated bar, bottom bracket and drivetrain installation.
